# Mosaique Journeys

> Mosaique Journeys designs private, tailor-made tours of Uzbekistan and the
> Silk Road for international travellers, with local expertise, hand-picked
> expert guides, and 24/7 on-the-ground support.

## About
- Type: Luxury / bespoke travel agency (private guided tours)
- Region: Uzbekistan & Central Asia (the Silk Road)
- Languages: English, Russian, German, French, Spanish, Italian
- Contact: hello@mosaiquejourneys.com · +998 71 200 70 07
- Booking model: no planning fees, no-obligation tailored quotes, private expert guides
- Founder: Mehrojbonu Ochilova, an Uzbek travel and cultural-exchange specialist

## Destinations
- Samarkand — Registan, Shah-i-Zinda, Bibi-Khanym, Gur-e-Amir
- Bukhara — Po-i-Kalyan / Kalyan Minaret, Lyab-i-Hauz, Chor Minor, trading domes
- Khiva — Itchan Kala walled old city, Islam Khodja, Kalta Minor
- Tashkent — capital, easy arrival city, Chorsu Bazaar
- Fergana Valley — Margilan silk, Rishtan ceramics (craft routes)
- Nukus & the Aral Sea region — Savitsky Museum, desert landscapes
- Shahrisabz — Amir Timur heritage
- Nuratau Mountains & Kyzylkum desert — yurt camps under the stars

## Signature journeys
- Classic Uzbekistan — 9 days; Tashkent, Samarkand, Bukhara, Khiva, Tashkent; from €1,350 pp for 2 guests or €1,050 pp for 4 guests
- Silk Road Cities & Desert Experience — 11 days; Tashkent, Samarkand, Bukhara, Khiva, ancient Khorezm fortresses, Ayaz Kala, Tashkent; from €1,950 pp for 2 guests or €1,650 pp for 4 guests
- Uzbekistan Grand Discovery — 14 days; Tashkent, Kokand, Fergana Valley, Samarkand, Shahrisabz, Bukhara, Vobkent, Khiva, Tashkent; from €2,650 pp for 2 guests or €2,250 pp for 4 guests

## Pricing basis
Indicative retail “from” rates assume 3- to 4-star hotels, double or twin
rooms, breakfast, airport transfers, private transportation, an
English-speaking guide, specified train tickets and domestic flights,
entrance fees, and the village experience where included. Optional
masterclasses are excluded. Final prices vary with season, hotel and room
category, group size, availability, and optional experiences.

## Travel styles
Couples, families, groups, solo travellers; cultural, desert, slow travel,
food, craft & artisans, and adventure journeys.

## Why Mosaique
Founded in Uzbekistan by Mehrojbonu Ochilova and supported by trusted local
guides, experienced drivers, and specialists across the country. Mosaique
combines genuine Uzbek hospitality with responsible travel and private,
tailor-made journey planning.
